jobs.title: Marketing Generalist - Saudi Arabia 🇸🇦
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 800+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⭐ Your mission

We are building Alan in Saudi Arabia, and you will be the person who makes us known, trusted, and chosen.

As Alan's first marketing hire in Saudi, you will sit at the intersection of strategy and execution, working hand-in-hand with the Saudi GM. You won't wait for a playbook to be handed to you, you'll help write it, then execute it yourself. You'll be the one who turns Alan's global assets into locally resonant stories, generates the first pipeline signals, and builds the brand that makes the best companies in Riyadh want to be Alan customers.

Your missions will include:

Strategy & Execution (in one role)

  • Work directly with the Saudi GM to build annual, quarterly & monthly go-to-market plans and execute the experiments yourself. This is a hands-on role — you own both the thinking and the doing.

  • Prioritise ruthlessly: in a market where Alan is not yet known, you'll sequence brand and awareness ahead of a mature inbound machine, and adjust as signals come in.

Brand, Comms & Social (your primary mandate)

You'll own how Alan shows up in Saudi and make it culturally resonant — this is what will actually make Alan cut through.

  • Establish Alan as a top-of-mind, trusted brand in Saudi, adapting Alan's global brand initiatives into locally and culturally relevant campaigns (Arabic-native, attuned to local moments and employer expectations).

  • Own organic social end-to-end — define Alan Saudi's social voice and editorial pillars, and activate the right platforms for a B2B and employer-brand audience (LinkedIn as anchor, plus Instagram/TikTok/YouTube as they fit), consistent with global frameworks but locally led.

  • Lead PR and comms for Saudi milestones — coordinate media opportunities and press releases to position Alan's voice in local health and employee-benefits conversations.

  • Bring strong copywriting and storytelling instincts — every word you write should earn its place.

What success looks like: Alan is increasingly known and trusted among target buyers in Saudi. Branded organic traffic and brand awareness are growing, social is building a qualified local audience, and Alan is showing up credibly in the market's conversations.


Content & SEO/GEO

  • Build and maintain Alan's Saudi website presence, ensuring it reflects local messaging and SEO/GEO priorities.

  • Produce and prioritise content (blogs, videos, social posts, adapting global playbooks) that builds awareness and creates organic search presence.

  • Localise Alan's global SEO/GEO playbook and rigorously track impact.

Events into inbound growth

Build repeatable event formats and make sure their impact extends beyond the room. You will support events by:

  • Supporting event logistics, timelines, registration pages, and materials

  • Creating follow-up emails and digital touchpoints after events

  • Turning event themes and conversations into content

  • Helping Sales follow up with the right people

  • Using event activity to create retargeting audiences, campaign inputs, and reusable content

What success looks like: Events that are well supported operationally and consistently translated into digital, content, and inbound inputs that can be reused over time.

👀 Who we are looking for

  • You are a genuine swiss knife. You are equally comfortable writing a press release, building a landing page, and hosting a breakfast event for HR leaders. You don't wait for specialists: your role spans across brand, growth, and product marketing. You spot and fill the gap yourself.

  • You go local first. You understand that global assets are a starting point, not a finish line. You naturally translate messages, visuals, and events into what resonates in the Saudi market.

  • You are data-driven, not opinion-driven. You define success metrics before you start. You know the difference between vanity metrics and the ones that actually move the pipeline.

  • You build to last. When you build something, you document it so it scales. You think in systems and playbooks, not one-offs.

  • You thrive in 0-to-1. The absence of a fully-built machine energises you rather than frustrates you. Ambiguity is something you resolve, not something you escalate.

  • You are a natural collaborator. You work closely with Sales, feed them what they need, and you're comfortable spending time in customer conversations to test your narratives and positiong live.

 

⭐️ Requirements for the role

Must-haves

  • 4–6 years of experience in growth or generalist marketing, ideally in a startup or scaleup environment

  • Demonstrated versatility across multiple mission areas (brand, content/SEO, events, product marketing)

  • Fluent in Arabic and English (written and spoken).

  • Strong copywriting and storytelling skills: can write compelling copy in both Arabic and English

  • Hands-on experience with paid platforms (Google Ads and/or LinkedIn Ads)

  • Comfort with data: can set up basic tracking, read dashboards, and iterate based on performance

  • Entrepreneurial mindset: a self-starter who doesn't need a 50-person team to make things happen

Nice to haves

  • Experience in B2B SaaS, healthtech, insurtech or HR tech

  • Familiarity with the Saudi or GCC business landscape and HR buyer profiles

  • Experience with SEO tools (Semrush, Ahrefs, Search Console)

  • Experience with CRM and marketing automation platforms

  • Has worked as a first or early marketing hire before

Level target: C1–D on Alan's level grid

⭐ What we offer

  • Competitive salary: we believe in paying well and trusting people to do great work

  • Meaningful equity: you are building this from scratch, and you should share in what you create

  • A world-class team to lean on: you won't be alone. You'll have the full support of Alan's international sales, product, and operations teams

  • Alan's health coverage (of course 😊)

  • The tools to do your best work: MacBook, the best software, and an environment built for focus

  • Real ownership and impact: you are not a cog in a machine. You are the machine.

#LI-DNP

jobs.title: Care Lead - Saudi Arabia
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 800+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⭐ Your mission

We are building Alan's Care function in Saudi Arabia, and you will be the person who makes sure every member trusts Alan when they need us most. You'll build the function from zero: process, tooling, quality bar, then scale it, while handling the conversations that matter most yourself.

Founding the function

  • Handle directly the member contacts that stay in-house: admin requests, escalations, complex cases.

  • Write the scripts, guidelines, and documentation that make Care work in Saudi from day one.

  • Shape the operating model on the ground together with the GM Saudi and the global Care community: opening hours, shift coverage, tooling setup (Intercom and others), and how traffic splits between in-house and externalized support.

What success looks like: a documented, working Care operation that can pass regulatory scrutiny and handle real member conversations from launch.

Owning quality on externalized support

  • Own the quality bar for everything we externalize: review calls and tickets in Arabic, coach our outsourcing partner's agents, and close the loop between what members experience and what we improve.

What success looks like: externalized conversations meet Alan's quality bar, and gaps get caught and fixed before they become member complaints.

Owning regulatory accountability

  • Own the complaint-handling policy and the regulatory SLAs on complaints.

  • Prepare the documentation and readiness for the Insurance Authority inspection.

What success looks like: Alan passes Insurance Authority inspection with a clear, accountable answer on every complaint-handling question asked.

You won't be building this alone. You'll have the full support of Alan's global Care Ops team on process design, tooling, forecasting, and planning, the same team behind our Care launches in France, Belgium, and Canada. You bring the on-the-ground execution and Arabic-language expertise; they bring the playbooks and cross-market experience.

👀 Who we are looking for

  • You are a founding operator. You've built an operational function from scratch before, or you're ready to do it for the first time with real ownership.

  • You are hands-on in ambiguity. You're happy to answer tickets yourself on day one while designing the system in parallel. Some decisions on coverage model and tooling are still being finalized, and you'll help make them.

  • You are AI-first. You're excited to work on automation and tooling, not just process.

  • You lead with ownership and directness. You hold an outsourcing partner accountable to a quality bar without hesitation.

  • You are genuinely energized by great customer experience. When a member is frustrated, you don't just close the ticket, you make sure they walk away feeling cared for.

  • You understand the member's stakes. Ideally, you've seen pre-authorization, claims, or member frustration points up close, in health insurance, health services, or a comparable regulated environment.

⭐️ Requirements for the role

Must-haves

  • Saudi national.

  • Fluent in Arabic and English, spoken and written. Both are mandatory: Arabic for the QA work on Arabic-language conversations, English for collaboration with the global Care community and cross-functional teams.

  • Comfortable operating with significant ambiguity: building the system and doing the work at the same time.

  • Strong ownership and directness, including holding an external partner accountable to a quality bar.

  • Genuine interest in AI-first tooling and automation.

Nice-to-haves

  • Health insurance, health services, or financial services background; understanding of pre-authorization, claims, and member frustration points in Saudi Arabia.

  • Experience building or scaling an operational/support function from scratch.

  • Familiarity with the Saudi regulatory environment (Insurance Authority requirements).

Level target: B1-C1 on Alan's level grid.

⭐ What we offer

  • A world-class team to lean on: you won't be alone. You'll have the full support of Alan's global Care Ops team, and the full team's playbooks from launching Care in France, Belgium, and Canada.

  • Real ownership and impact from day one, on a function you build yourself.

  • As the team scales, this role has the potential to grow into leading a local team.

jobs.title: Founding Sales 🇸🇦
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 800+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⭐️ The Founding Sales opportunity

We are looking for our first-ever Sales hire in Saudi Arabia — a rare founding opportunity to build Alan's commercial practice in the Kingdom from the ground up.

You will be Alan's flag-bearer in KSA: the person who shapes how we sell, who we sell to, and how we build relationships with companies that want to offer their employees a truly great health experience.

This is not a role for someone looking for a well-defined playbook to execute. It is a role for someone who wants to write the playbook — and who has the experience to do so.

⭐️ Your mission

You’ll own the entire sales cycle, from prospecting and outreach to discovery, demo, offer building, and closing.

At Alan, Account Executives drive deals and close strategic opportunities with prospects. We sometimes handle some customer relationships to ensure the best possible onboarding. You’ll educate prospects, provide inspiring product demos, and onboard key stakeholders, making the transition from prospect to customer seamless.

We expect you to understand and apply the Alan Smart & Soft selling method. This method ensures the prospect experience is an integral part of the overall Alan customer experience—making it pleasant and delightful for everyone. We expect you to be instructive to prospects (Smart), as well as to define the best personalized high-touch strategy that suits best each prospect (Soft).

You’ll also help us grow and improve as a company, challenging us to enhance our product(s), methods, and strategy, and getting involved in initiatives to expand our customer base.

As Founding Sales for KSA, you will also:

  • Build Alan's local presence with HR Directors, CFOs, and C-level decision-makers at companies who care about their employees' wellbeing

  • Act as the eyes and ears of the company in KSA — feeding market intelligence, prospect feedback, and local insights back to the product and strategy teams

  • Shape the sales function in KSA — setting the rituals, tools, and standards that future teammates will build on

  • Evangelize Alan's approach in the market, positioning Alan as a trusted and innovative health partner for Saudi employers

  • Contribute to Alan globally — leveraging and enriching the playbooks built in France, Belgium, Spain, and Canada


⭐ Is it you we’re looking for?

You’ll be a great fit if you:

  • Are currently allowed to work legally for any employer in KSA, based in or willing to relocate to Riyadh

  • Have Saudi citizenship

  • Have 5+ years of B2B sales experience, ideally in the tech or SaaS space (you are familiar with product demos, discovery frameworks, complex deal cycles)

  • Have demonstrated the ability to prospect, close, and build — not just manage existing accounts

  • Are highly autonomous — you thrive in ambiguous, fast-moving environments and don't need a fully built machine to be effective

  • Have native or fluent Arabic

  • Have strong written and verbal communication skills in English

  • Are analytical, organized, and rigorous — you manage your pipeline with precision

  • Have empathy — you genuinely care about understanding and solving the problems of the companies and people you work with

  • Are not driven primarily by commissions — you are motivated by impact, ownership, and long-term value creation

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the C1-D level range.

If you're still wondering whether this could be the best move for you, take a look at this article from Lucie Leflour, our Sales Lead in France.


Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team.


🙌   Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Competitive base salary — above market, no commission model. We believe in paying well and trusting people to do great work

  • Meaningful equity — you are building this from scratch, and you should share in what you create

  • A world-class team to lean on — you won't be alone. You'll have the full support of Alan's international sales, product, and operations teams

  • Alan's health coverage (of course 😊)

  • The tools to do your best work — MacBook, the best software, and an environment built for focus

  • Real ownership and impact — you are not a cog in a machine. You are the machine.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist.

We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.
